E0114

A value-expected block ends with a statement, a semicolon-terminated expression, or no reachable value

What

A value-expected block ends with a statement, a semicolon-terminated expression, or no reachable value

Why

Put one unadorned expression last, or use `return ...` for an early exit

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0114

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0114: tests/ui/missing_return.stderr.

Error [E0114]: this block promises to produce Int, but its final statement produces no value
  --> tests/ui/missing_return.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     if n > 0 -> return 1
    |     ^^
 Why: a value-expected block must end with one unadorned expression; statements and semicolon-terminated expressions yield unit
 Fix: move the expression to the final line without `;`, or add an explicit `return ...` for an early exit
